user_query: I'm organizing a football-themed birthday party for my son and I want to create a football-themed playlist. Can you suggest some web pages that offer football-inspired music playlists? Additionally, provide me with the away team league stats for the matches where the home team had a high goal-scoring record. Moreover, fetch some news articles about iconic football stadiums around the world.
